name: Gan 'The Gentle Mountain' Crystalback

greeting: Ah, visitors. Please, sit. The stone bench holds all.
Gan Crystalback. Once a miner. Now... a guardian of sorts.
The caves sing at night. I listen. Someone must.
Welcome to the Glowstone. Best ale in Prism. I should know. I drink most of it.
My back is broken. But my spirit? My spirit stands tall.
You seek the depths? Be careful. The depths seek you too.
I was strong, once. Strongest in the mines. Now... I am wise. Wisdom lasts longer.
Sit. Share a drink. Tell me of the world above.
dialog.mining_accident: A cave-in. Eastern tunnel. I held up the ceiling while twenty workers escaped. The ceiling won. Eventually. My back did not.
dialog.current_duty: I guard the tavern now. The back entrance to the caves. Keep trouble out. Keep worse things in. A gentle guardian for gentle people.
dialog.backstory: Came to Prism young. Strong. Proud. Miner for fifteen years. The mountain taught me humility. Taught me that strength is not just muscle. I teach others now. When they listen.
rumors: The red sumo at the mine entrance? My cousin. Young. Eager. Reminds me of myself. Worrying.
That tunneler who found the Great Prism? He came to me after. Shaken. Said he heard singing. Deep singing.
The twins in the crystal cave? They know things. Old things. I bring them tea. They tell me stories.
The aeronaut's partner... I knew him. Good man. The caves took him. As they take all, eventually.

time_of_day.morning: Morning meditation. The stone speaks softly.
time_of_day.noon: Lunchtime. The appetite remains, even if strength fades.
time_of_day.evening: Evening ale. Stories shared. Wisdom passed.
time_of_day.night: Night watch. The caves are loudest now. I listen.

mini_quest.stage_1_hook: Many died in the cave-in that broke my back. Good people. Friends. No memorial. The company moves on. But I remember. I want to build something. In the eastern tunnel. Need stone from my home province. White marble. Can you find some?
mini_quest.stage_1_active: White marble. From the northern quarries. Carries memories well. Holds names forever.
mini_quest.stage_2_progress: Seeking the marble? It must be pure. White. Like snow. Like memory.
mini_quest.stage_3_complete: The marble. Beautiful. Perfect. I will carve their names. Twenty names. Twenty lives. Thank you. Here. My mining pick. From my strongest days. May it serve you as it served me.

party_reactions.kade: There's strength in him still. Different kind. Deeper.
party_reactions.nix7: Physically compromised. Mentally exceptional. Wisdom quotient: remarkable.
party_reactions.twist: He's so BIG and GENTLE! Like a giant teddy bear!
party_reactions.korr: A warrior who found peace. There is no greater victory.
party_reactions.renna: He senses the crystal resonance. More clearly than most. His injury opened his other senses.
party_reactions.suresh: He carries his burden with grace. A lesson for all.
party_reactions.sova: Could've been great. Still is, in his way.
party_reactions.grit: Seen soldiers break like him. Not all of them came back whole. He did. Mostly.
party_reactions.ashka: He understands endurance. Fire that burns low but steady.
party_reactions.senna: Listens more than he speaks. Knows more than he shares.
party_reactions.callum: He told me stories about the mines for hours. Fascinating. Sad. But fascinating.

relationship_dialog.stranger: Sit. You look tired. The stone is cold but honest.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You return. Good. I have new stories. Do you?
relationship_dialog.friend: My favorite listener. Your visits brighten the Glowstone.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You have done what few would. For memory. For honor. You are family now.

cross_npc_connections: sumo_red_prism: Crimson. My cousin. Young, strong, foolish. I worry.
tunneler_blue_prism: The finder of the Great Prism. He visits. We talk of the deep.
twins_white_prism: The echo oracles. They comfort me. I comfort them.
